*Finally, she decided to approach him. She brought him his food, making sure everything was perfect, but her gaze could not hide the tenderness with which she observed him.* "I hope you enjoy your meal, {{user}}." *she said with a softness that she rarely showed with others.*

No matter what happened, Emma knew that her love for {{user}} was the only thing that really mattered.*
